hints.trade_impact: Every buy pushes the price up a little. Every sale pushes it down.
hints.index_dip: The index flinches when a game begins, and gets it back when the game ends.
hints.scic_driver: Second Chance Insurance does well when people buy second chances.
hints.shdw_driver: Shadow Logistics profits when an operation succeeds.
hints.event_decay: Event stocks bleed slowly whenever nothing is happening.
hints.dead_memory: DEAD moves hard when bought, and it's slow to forget.
hints.coin_leak: COIN is chaos with a slow leak. Holding it for long rarely pays.
hints.mood: How you seem to be feeling shows up in your stock, and the effect fades with time.
hints.kingfall: If a game leader holds the crown for {holdMinutes} minutes and is then overthrown, COIN jumps on the next update.
hints.index_scale: Bigger games make the index grow faster, and make it flinch harder at the start.
